Index: .dockerignore
===================================================================
--- .dockerignore	
+++ .dockerignore	
@@ -1,15 +1,14 @@
 node_modules
 .expo
 .expo-shared
 dist
 build
 *.tsbuildinfo
 .git
 .gitignore
-node_modules
 logs
 *.log
 cache
 temp
 tmp
-coverage
+coverage
\ No newline at end of file

Index: Dockerfile
===================================================================
--- Dockerfile	
+++ Dockerfile	
@@ -1,19 +1,17 @@
 FROM node:20-alpine
 
 WORKDIR /app
 
-# Install dependencies
-RUN npm install -g expo-cli
+# Install OpenJDK 21 for Android development
+RUN apk add --no-cache openjdk21 freetype giflib jpeg lcms2 libpng
 
-# Copy package files
-COPY package*.json ./
+# Set JAVA_HOME for Android builds
+ENV JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk
+ENV PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
 
-# Install dependencies
-RUN npm install
-
-# Copy project files
+# Copy project files (dependencies and source)
 COPY . .
 
 EXPOSE 8081 19000 19001
 
-CMD ["npx", "expo", "start", "--dev-client", "--clear"]
+CMD ["npx", "expo", "start", "--dev-client", "--clear"]
\ No newline at end of file

Index: build-android.sh
===================================================================
--- build-android.sh	
+++ build-android.sh	
@@ -1,28 +1,28 @@
-#!/bin/bash
+#!/bin/sh
 set -e
 
 echo "=========================================="
 echo "Cargo Mobile - APK Build Script"
 echo "=========================================="
 
 cd /app
 
 # Install dependencies
 echo "📦 Installing dependencies..."
 npm install
 
 # Generate android native code
 echo "🔧 Generating Android native code..."
 npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean
 
 # Build debug APK
 echo "🔨 Building debug APK..."
 cd android
 ./gradlew assembleDebug
 
 # Show output
 echo ""
 echo "=========================================="
 echo "✅ Build Complete!"
 echo "=========================================="
 ls -lh app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ 2>/dev/null || echo "APK output not found"

Index: docker-compose.yml
===================================================================
--- docker-compose.yml	
+++ docker-compose.yml	
@@ -1,40 +1,39 @@
 services:
   # Expo Mobile App (Development)
   mobile-app:
     build: .
     container_name: cargo-mobile-app
     ports:
       - "8081:8081"  # Expo Dev Server
       - "19000:19000"  # Expo REPL
       - "19001:19001"  # Expo Web
     environment:
       - NODE_ENV=development
       - EXPO_DEV=true
       - API_URL=https://simia.tehransaadat.com/api/v1
     volumes:
       - .:/app
-      - /app/node_modules
     working_dir: /app
     command: ["npx", "expo", "start", "--dev-client", "--clear"]
 
   # Backend API (Cargo) - existing in TehranSaadat
   backend:
     image: php:8.2-apache
     container_name: cargo-backend
     working_dir: /var/www/html
     volumes:
       - ../:/var/www/html
     environment:
       - APACHE_DOCUMENT_ROOT=/var/www/html
       - DB_HOST=irex-postgres
       - DB_NAME=cargodb
       - DB_USER=root
       - DB_PASSWORD=root
     expose:
       - "8080"
     networks:
       - default
 
 networks:
   default:
     driver: bridge
